chunks: "Wash your hand after urine once, after defecation twice, and after janabah (ritual impurity) three times."

key_terms.الْجَنابَةِ: janabah, a state of major ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: How many times should the hand be washed after urine, defecation, and janabah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal instruction concerning washing the hand after different kinds of impurity. It distinguishes between urine, defecation, and janabah, assigning one, two, and three washes respectively as part of ritual purity practice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.91 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Wash your hand after urine once, after defecation twice, and after janabah (ritual impurity) three times."
